description:
Thanks to Alienware for sponsoring our PC performance reviews. To learn more about the Alienware AREA-51 Gaming Desktop, check out: http://aw.gg/digitalfoundry

While FSR 4 has been available "unofficially" for a long, long time on older AMD graphics cards, the firm's recent release for the ML upscaler for RDNA 3 feels like a shot in the arm for RX 7000 GPUs, while the Steam Machine also stands to benefit. Rich benchmarks the Valve mini-PC/console, RX 7800 XT and 7900 XTX and puts the upscaler to work in numerous gameplay scenarios. Perhaps it's an exaggeration to say that an older GPU feels new again, but the tech can be transformative.
